_comment: Every algorithm in the Quantum Algorithm Zoo must have a disposition here, or tooling/reconcile_algorithm_zoo.py fails. Exact name matches against algorithm_zoo_index.json need no entry - only judgement calls are recorded, because only judgement calls need a human. Keys are Zoo names normalised to lowercase alphanumerics separated by single spaces.

aliases._comment: Same algorithm, different name. The Zoo names the problem; we tend to name the algorithm or its author. Values must exist verbatim in algorithm_zoo_index.json.

excluded._comment: Deliberately absent. A polynomial or constant-factor speedup does not survive error-correction overhead, so these fail Troyer F3 and cannot produce a QUANTUM verdict even if indexed. Recorded rather than ignored so the decision is visible and can be revisited if the QEC picture changes.
excluded.ordered search: Constant-factor speedup only; fails F3 outright.
excluded.primality proving: Polynomial speedup; fails F3, and classical AKS is already polynomial.

candidates._comment: Absent from the index, and absent for no good reason. These carry a superpolynomial or exponential claim, or an unresolved one, which means the router can never return QUANTUM for a problem they would answer. Listed so the gap is counted rather than discovered. Promotion needs a speedup class, I/O and guiding-state assessment per entry, which is human work.
candidates.class group: Superpolynomial. Hidden-subgroup family, no counterpart indexed.
candidates.hidden nonlinear structures: Superpolynomial. Generalises hidden-subgroup; nothing indexed covers it.
candidates.non abelian hidden subgroup: Superpolynomial. We index the abelian case only, and the non-abelian case is the harder and largely open one.
candidates.principal ideal: Superpolynomial. Related to Pell's Equation, which we do index, but not the same problem.
candidates.decoding: Speedup recorded as Varies; needs a per-case reading before it can carry a verdict.
candidates.polynomial interpolation: Speedup recorded as Varies; needs a per-case reading.
candidates.double bracket quantum algorithms: Speedup recorded as Unknown; too recent for the Zoo to have classified.
candidates.tensor principal component analysis: Speedup unclassified in the Zoo source; needs a reading.
